id: title:dmarchuk:bucket invocations sparkline in the project timezone

review.posthog_relevance: ClickHouse warehouse ingestion and HogQL-invocation sparkline visualization
review.reason: The change implements timezone-aware bucket alignment and date handling for HogQL-invocation sparklines, replacing UTC-aligned milliseconds with team-local wall-clock steps. This ensures that the frontend x-axis and filter windows correctly align with ClickHouse's timezone-aware bucket boundaries, preventing chart display errors where invocations would land on the wrong instant. P1
